name: Drevsin Passionfruit-Anise Cola
description: An unusual dark cola base blended with synth-passionfruit and a real star anise extract, producing a cola that reads as both tropical and vaguely medicinal. Drevsin is a small regional brand that has maintained its niche through consistent weirdness.
flavor_profile: Cola backbone with a tropical passionfruit sweetness, then a licorice-adjacent anise depth that lingers — sweet, strange, and oddly satisfying
slogan: Cola for people who think too much.
cultural_context: Drevsin has a devoted cult following among late-night workers, artists, and the chronically online. It's the soda you drink at 02:00 while doing something you probably shouldn't. The brand leans into this identity with minimal advertising and maximum community mythology.
story_hooks: A Drevsin limited batch from two years ago — the Anise Black run — has become a collector's item, with single cans trading for Φ200 or more in secondary markets; someone is selling counterfeits
Drevsin's head formulator disappeared six months ago, leaving behind only a notebook filled with flavor equations that nobody on the team can fully interpret

A BCI-art collective has been using Drevsin's flavor profile as a synesthetic anchor in an immersive installation — the corponation whose building they installed it in hasn't decided whether to shut it down or commission more
